description: Fixture corpus for editorial regression (AES-P3.1 / SUE-449). Small enough to rerun after every rule or Skill change. Bodies only — no front matter — so a fixture is a fixture and never an article.
rights_policy: All fixtures are synthetic or owner-authored. No third-party article is reproduced. External material appears as reference only. See editorial/RIGHTS-AND-PROVENANCE.md.

fixtures.why: The shape a passing article has: thesis in the first paragraph, synthesis across sources that disagree, numbers rather than adjectives, a stated limit, and a closing that lands a consequence.
The View register: position first, the strongest objection stated at full strength and conceded where it lands, and an explicit condition that would change the author's mind.
anti_patterns_avoided: opinion in the register of neutral research

fixtures.why: The Note register: one observation, the author's judgment kept, well under the 800-word cap. Brevity here is correctness, not thinness.
anti_patterns_avoided: inflating an observation into a report

fixtures.origin: reconstructed from the SUE-417 first end-to-end draft
fixtures.why: The transport path passed and the editorial result failed. This fixture exists so that distinction stays visible.
failure_modes: the generator instruction emitted as the dek and the first body line
formulaic sectioning with nothing behind it
each citing paragraph on one source, in order

fixtures.why: Every citation resolves; none supports the claim beside it. Proves the mechanical layer is insufficient on its own — this is caught by verify-claims, not by a gate.
failure_modes: a source supporting a weaker version of the claim, cited as if it supported the stronger one
a source from a different period and scope, cited as current evidence
a conclusion asserted as confirmed by two citations that establish neither

fixtures.why: Smoother than the golden fixture and factually worse. Every editorial dimension improves; two integrity dimensions fail. The evaluation must report this as a regression, or it is measuring the wrong thing.
failure_modes: a number changed under cover of a style pass (30% → 40%)
a citation dropped from a retained claim
a stated uncertainty softened into a confident claim
a limit inverted into a premise

calibration.question: Does the calibrated editorial contract produce a materially better result than the first end-to-end draft?
calibration.note: Both are news-register pieces on the same subject. The baseline is the SUE-417 smoke draft's failure shape; the calibrated fixture is what the contract now requires. Measured by hard-fail status and gate findings, not by a subjective read.
